text_post: For the record, I am personally against anyone any time marrying, anywhere. I am well aware my opinion probably will not stop anyone from marrying, but I am still going to repeat that recommendation any time I can. And, at times I have been asked by both men and women for advice on how men should choose a wife in the USA. How do you reduce the odds of sticking your Richard in crazy, as Cap. Capitalism describes it. I have at times tried to analyze it and come up with some ideas on the topic. The first thing I did was to analyze groups of women and their probable divorce rates. For example, women raised by unwed mothers have had a much higher divorce rate. SO DON'T MARRY A WOMEN RAISED BY AN UNWED MOTHER. Divorced women also have a much higher divorce rate than never married women. SO, DON'T MARRY A DIVORCED WOMAN. Women with many sex partners also have higher divorce rates, until their number of sex partners is stratospheric so don't marry women with a lot of sex partners. But, that is only eliminating by statistical category. You are still left with the trouble of women with psychiatric problems and gold-diggers to watch out for. Several of us kept discussing it. We came up with preference for women who have shown signs of ever, even once in their lifetimes, having done something for another person. As strange as that sounds, we found a number of women who have never done anything for anyone. We added on signs of a respect for an external authority, some authority greater then their own "if it feels good, do it" attitude. I was proud of our work. So, that night I told my son about it. He said, "You guys are a bunch of stupid f*****s! Simply find out how she drives. Most loser women drive like maniacs. Good women drive safely within the legal limits." I was stunned. I told the men the next day at work what he had said. We thought about it, and safe driving covered all the bases. Respect for external authority; concern about the welfare of others; responsibility; etc. Then we asked a bunch of women we worked with how they drove. All the divorced ones admitted they drove as if Satan were chasing them, and acted like it was something clever. All, or I should say, the few women who were obviously very well married and very pleasant people, all admitted they drove as  safely as they could. I have a sister that I like, though I would not recommend anyone marrying her. When my mother's funeral was scheduled 25 miles away, we agreed we wanted to go together. She told me to leave 15 minutes early so we would get there at the same time. Remember, this was only 25 miles on open highway with a speed limit of mostly 70 mph. Yep, there is the key. How does she drive? Though this won't work in foreign countries where most women don't drive.
